disappearance of the head movements while asleep implies that their origin may lie within the\u0026nbsp;extrapyramidal system\u0026nbsp;which is a part of the motor system that controls coordination of movement. The tracts associated with the extrapyramidal system are controlled by various structures of the\u0026nbsp;central nervous system, such as the\u0026nbsp;cerebellum\u0026nbsp;and\u0026nbsp;basal ganglia. The basal ganglia plays a large part in controlling motor function and thus, abnormalities to this system can result in movement disorders such as\u0026nbsp;Parkinson's disease\u0026nbsp;and\u0026nbsp;dyskinesia, both of which share commonalities with bobble-head doll syndrome.\"\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/en.m.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Bobble-head_doll_syndrome\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4. 24Y F with Fever and Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.This e-log book also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on comment box is welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI've been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECONSENT AND DE-IDENTIFICATION :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient and the attenders have been adequately informed about this documentation and privacy of the patient is being entirely conserved. No identifiers shall be revealed through out the piece of work whatsoever.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC\/o itchy lesions over back,neck,face since 3 months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInitially started over back and progressed to hands\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC\/o fever since 2 months(one episode per day in the evening)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EComplaints of oral ulcers since 1 month\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC\/o joint pains since 15 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently normal 3 months back And started Having itchy lesions over back its progress to hands,Neck. oral ulcers since one month.High grade fever, one episode per day, relieved on taking medication.Joint pain since 15 days associated with swelling.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo history of morning stiffness.painful oral ulcers since one month, associated with difficulty in swallowing and burning sensation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of two episodes of vomiting,Non projectile, non bilious with food particles non blood tinged.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of three episodes of diarrhea per day for two days, which is water in consistency. No occult blood is present in stools. No history of new drug intake prior to symptom.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo history of dry eyes,Mouth Reynauds phenomenon.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of swelling of face One month back.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o chestpain,Dyspnea,palpitations\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o photosensivity present\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o elephantiasis of right leg since 25yrs\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o diarrhoea and vomiting since 15 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDenovo detected hypothyroidism\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o usage Tab.omnacortil 30mg,T.Augmentin 625mg,Betamethasone lotion\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
